verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships an official CLI called clai for chatting with LLMs from the terminal, plus Agent.to_cli_sync() to launch CLI mode directly from an agent instance, documented in first-party docs and confirmed by a probe. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of the clai CLI (community evidence covers other features but not this CLI's real-world use), and no detail on advanced CLI-specific agentic workflows beyond chat.
